title: Small directed finite-subsum presentation of a given coproduct
statement: Let X be any scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], I an arbitrary index type, F_i module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and S a coproduct with inclusions iota_i [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. There exist a nonempty directed preorder A in Type u (the universe of X), a functor D from A to module sheaves, and a colimit cocone with point S. For each a in A there exist a finite subset J of I and an isomorphism e from D(a) to the finite biproduct of F_j for j in J [def-sp-abelian], such that inclusion of F_j followed by e inverse and the cocone leg equals iota_j. The empty finite subset is allowed. No cohomological or compactness hypotheses occur.

source.place: Tag 01AH (colimits); finite-subsum construction in cohomology.tex, Tag 09J7, and Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Limits.Constructions.Filtered. Universe reduction is the projection/section argument already recorded in the parent node proof, expanded in the docstring.

proof.text: For each index, use the given coproduct universal property to define a projection to that summand which is identity on that component and zero on others. Map each nonzero index to the projection followed by its inclusion, an endomorphism of S. If two distinct indices give the same endomorphism, precompose and postcompose with the inclusion and projection of the first index: its identity equals zero, contradicting nonzeroness. Hence the nonzero index subtype injects into End(S), which is u-small. The Lean private helper small_coproduct_support proves this directly. Restrict the cofan to the nonzero subtype: extend maps by zero on the remaining indices; uniqueness follows from uniqueness of maps out of zero objects.

Shrink the nonzero subtype N to B : Type u and whisker its cofan by the discrete equivalence, preserving the coproduct universal property. Use Mathlib liftToFinsetObj and finiteSubcoproductsCocone on Finset (Discrete B). The finite-subcoproduct colimit theorem proves this is a colimit; extend the cocone along the unique coproduct isomorphism to the given S. Finset supplies nonemptiness and directedness, including when B is empty.

For a finite stage a, the injective map from Discrete B to I produces J = a.map f and the equivalence E = Finset.equivMap f a. Compose the inverse biproduct.isoCoproduct with biproduct.whiskerEquiv E (fun _ => Iso.refl _) to obtain the stage isomorphism. Every coproduct inclusion composed with its hom is the corresponding biproduct inclusion. Cancel hom followed by inv, apply Sigma.ι_desc_assoc and the component equation for the unique coproduct isomorphism: the required composite equals the original iota_j.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_small_finiteSubsum_diagram (X : Scheme.{u}) (I : Type v)
    (F : I → SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))
    (S : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) (ι : ∀ i : I, F i ⟶ S)
    (hS : IsColimit (Cofan.mk S ι)) :
    ∃ (A : Type u) (_ : Preorder A) (_ : Nonempty A) (_ : IsDirected A (· ≤ ·))
      (D : A ⥤ SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))
      (τ : D ⟶ (Functor.const A).obj S) (_ : IsColimit (Cocone.mk S τ)),
      ∀ a : A, ∃ (J : Finset I) (e : D.obj a ≅ ⨁ (fun j : J ↦ F j)),
        ∀ j : J, biproduct.ι (fun j : J ↦ F j) j ≫ e.inv ≫ τ.app a = ι j
